title: Mirzapur: The Movie
shortDescription: The Mirzapur saga concludes on the big screen with Guddu and Golu's final war for the throne.
review: Mirzapur: The Movie brings the long-running crime saga to a cinematic close. The pacing is tighter than the series, the performances remain the show's biggest strength, and the final act delivers the payoff fans have waited years for. Not a perfect film, but a satisfying send-off.
